echelon_layering: AEE layers the echelon at runtime; it is not baked into the frame .paa. Each AEE_Ech_* texture is 64 x 128 with the ticks in the top band and transparent below, so it sits above a frame marker placed at the same position. The canvas is 64 x 128 (not 64 x 96) because Arma and hemtt require power-of-two texture dimensions.

unavailable.name: AEE_MT_Mission_Tasks
unavailable.title: Mission Tasks (base)
unavailable.reason: The base symbol has no template and no draw rule (both are N/A in the standard). It is a category header, not a graphic.

unavailable.name: AEE_MT_Escort
unavailable.title: Escort
unavailable.reason: Code 110132 is an entity subtype of a fixed-wing aircraft (role), not a mission-task graphic. FM 3-90 Appendix B does not list Escort. No standard graphic exists.

unavailable.name: AEE_MT_Exfiltrate
unavailable.title: Exfiltrate
unavailable.reason: FM 3-90 Appendix B defines Exfiltrate but gives no tactical mission graphic, and MIL-STD-2525D has no mission-task symbol for it.

unavailable.name: AEE_MT_Pursuit
unavailable.title: Pursuit
unavailable.reason: Absent from MIL-STD-2525D and FM 3-90 Appendix B. No standard graphic exists.

unavailable.name: AEE_MT_Reduce
unavailable.title: Reduce
unavailable.reason: FM 3-90 Appendix B states 'No tactical mission graphic.'

unavailable.name: AEE_MT_Suppress
unavailable.title: Suppress
unavailable.reason: No mission-task graphic in MIL-STD-2525D or FM 3-90; the only 'Suppress' entry (Suppression of Enemy Air Defense, 110130) is a different symbol.
